3. Test before submitting. Call `run_tests` on your current complete program and inspect every example result. If any example fails, do not submit: diagnose the discrepancy, fix the code, and test again. Use `run_python` for small calculations, brute-force comparisons, or edge cases when it can resolve uncertainty.
4. The code passed by `run_tests` must be exactly the code you submit. After any edit to the program—even a seemingly small cleanup or optimization—run `run_tests` again before submitting.
